name: GreenCode Hackathon
result: Selected among the top six teams for acceleration
awardSummary: SmartWater Zambia earned a place in the six-team acceleration programme, with follow-on support from Garage48 and BongoHive. The hackathon's €6,000 prize was awarded to the top three teams.
summary: Took SmartWater Zambia from an idea pitched on stage to a working prototype in 48 hours, then presented it to the judging panel as part of one of the six teams selected for acceleration and follow-on support.
contributions: Joined a cross-disciplinary team around a practical water problem and helped scope what a credible prototype could deliver inside 48 hours.
Built and iterated on the SmartWater Zambia prototype through Garage48’s validation, prototyping and pitching process with local and international mentors.
Pitched the finished prototype to the judging panel and finished in the top six, the group selected for acceleration and follow-on support from the organisers.
acknowledgement: Built at the GreenCode Hackathon Zambia Edition, run by Garage48 and BongoHive with ESTDEV, in Lusaka from 30 October to 1 November 2026. Thank you to the organisers for putting a hundred Zambian developers, designers and sustainability practitioners in one room with a real brief and real mentors; to the mentors and judges who pushed every team to validate before building; and to the six-team follow-on programme that gives this prototype a route beyond the weekend. Finishing in the top six is an opportunity rather than a trophy. The plan is to keep going: calibrate the hardware, harden the platform and put SmartWater Zambia in front of a Zambian utility or institution as a paid pilot.
